verdict.rationale: Fathom's docs describe a single account-level API key generated in User Settings (fathom-docs-1, fathom-docs-7) and an OAuth flow for public third-party apps (fathom-docs-5, fathom-docs-21), but nowhere is there evidence of scoped/granular permissions, role-based API keys, or least-privilege credential issuance for individual agents. The only permissions concept documented is admin-level 'View permissions' for accessing shared meetings, not scoped credential minting.
